title: light mediterranean applesauce stew
description: a delicate and flavorful stew featuring sashimi-cut vegetables and a floral, crisp mediterranean twist, perfect for a weekend brunch
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
add the sashimi-cut vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender.
stir in the granny smith applesauce and the juice of 1 lemon.
season with salt and pepper to taste.
serve the stew over hot stones in a shallow dish and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
garnish with chopped fresh parsley or thyme for a pop of color and flavor.
optional: add a dollop of tzatziki sauce on top for extra creaminess and flavor.
note: for an extra crispy texture, serve the stew over toasted pita chips or crostini.
